description_en: Unmounts KVCacheInstance resources from the virtualization side in batches
description_zh: 批量将 KVCacheInstance 从虚拟化侧卸载
name: DetachKVCacheStore

parameters.help_en: The region ID, such as cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

fields.help_en: The VSC ID on the compute side
fields.name: vsc_id

parameters.help_en: The list of resources to unmount. A maximum of 100 resources can be specified
parameters.help_zh: 待卸载的资源列表，最多 100 个
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: A string generated by the server that serves as a unique identifier for the client request
parameters.help_zh: 服务端生成的一串字符串，作为客户端进行请求的一个标识
parameters.name: client_token

Status.description_en:
The operation result. Valid values:

DETACHING: The request has been accepted and the asynchronous unmount is in progress. This value is also returned for idempotent calls.
Success: The synchronous validation passed and the asynchronous operation completed.
Failed: The operation failed
